summary: EFCAR, LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement for a securitization transaction. On August 31, 2026, EFCAR transferred sub-prime auto loan receivables to Exeter Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-4, which then transferred them to Exeter Holdings Trust 2026-4 in exchange for beneficial interests. The Trust issued asset-backed notes across eight classes totaling approximately $1.06 billion. This is a routine structured finance current report, not a special situation. The filing documents include a Purchase Agreement and Sale and Servicing Agreement. No special-situation event such as M&A or restructuring is present.
